description: Run a Reading on two people from the emails between them. Send at least 3 emails written by the user and 3 by the other person, oldest first. From the second Reading on a pair, send the record from the last Reading exactly as it was returned. Costs one Reading (the first 3 are free). Save the record from the answer with this pair.

emails.description: Oldest first. Each person is read from their own latest 20 emails, the first 3,000 characters of each.

sentAt.description: Date and time sent, such as 2026-10-01T14:30:00Z.

other.description: The person the user works with.

city.description: With state, switches on severe weather warnings.

country.description: ARVX reads people in the United States only. US switches on U.S. holidays.

email.description: Ties the record to this pair. Never stored, never sent to an AI model.

scores.description: Only results from a personality assessment the person agreed to. At least 5 of the 9 traits, each 1 to 10. Never results collected for a hiring decision, and never clinical tests. Leave this out to have the person read from their emails.

record.description: The record from the last Reading on these same two people, unchanged. Leave out on the first Reading.

email.description: Ties the record to this pair. Never stored, never sent to an AI model.

scores.description: Only results from a personality assessment the person agreed to. At least 5 of the 9 traits, each 1 to 10. Never results collected for a hiring decision, and never clinical tests. Leave this out to have the person read from their emails.

teamSize.description: People on the account, counting the user.

name: arvx_run_reading
